title: Composed supervisory control: Dual-event priority capture with lockout -> Qualified event capture with saturation

inputs.name: B_MaxCount
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Saturation limit, assumed at least one

outputs.name: A_Captured
outputs.description: Subsystem A: An event has been captured

outputs.name: A_Code
outputs.description: Subsystem A: 0 none, 1 event A, 2 event B

outputs.name: A_Pulse
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Capture occurred this scan

outputs.name: B_AcceptedPulse
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Accepted event this scan

outputs.name: B_AtLimit
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Count has reached MaxCount

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: B_MaxCount is constant during a test and is at least 1.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Captured, A_Code, and A_Pulse.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: While armed and not A_Captured, a rising A_EventA shall capture A_Code 1.
requirements.property: G((A_Arm AND !prev(A_Captured) AND rose(A_EventA) AND !A_Reset) -> (A_Captured AND (A_Code = 1) AND A_Pulse))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A simultaneous rising edge shall select A_EventA over A_EventB.
requirements.property: G((A_Arm AND rose(A_EventA) AND rose(A_EventB) AND !prev(A_Captured) AND !A_Reset) -> (A_Code = 1))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A rising A_EventB without A_EventA shall capture A_Code 2.
requirements.property: G((A_Arm AND !prev(A_Captured) AND !rose(A_EventA) AND rose(A_EventB) AND !A_Reset) -> (A_Code = 2))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: After capture, later events shall not change A_Code until A_Reset.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_Count and B_AcceptedPulse.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Only a rising B_Event edge with B_Qualify TRUE and B_Count below B_MaxCount shall increment B_Count.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_AcceptedPulse = (rose(B_Event) AND B_Qualify AND (prev(B_Count) < B_MaxCount) AND !B_Reset)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Count shall not exceed B_MaxCount.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_AtLimit shall be TRUE exactly when B_Count is at least B_MaxCount.
A TRUE A_Captured shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND B_Count=0 AND NOT B_AcceptedPulse AND NOT B_AtLimit)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (B_Count=0 AND NOT B_AcceptedPulse AND NOT B_AtLimit))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
